more.companies: More case studies: individuals and solo founders →

companies.need: Every report ran through a chaotic analyst workflow.
companies.solution: We mapped the workflow, built AI skills on a shared knowledge base, and set a quality bar against AI slop.
companies.result: Still in use on every report. They run it themselves.

companies.need: A team of 21 that wanted AI on their real work.
companies.solution: An AI at Work class on their files, then private sessions with the CEO, who built her own assistant.
companies.result: Her assistant still runs her daily brief and her weekly meeting tasks.

companies.need: A sales and marketing team new to AI.
companies.solution: A four-hour workshop in their office, for two owners and six employees.
companies.result: The owner still uses AI daily and keeps advancing. An ongoing relationship.

solo.industry: A shop owner in retail and e-commerce
solo.need: An owner who wanted AI to carry the routine work of a small shop.
solo.solution: Private sessions: a second brain, an inventory intake, a travel workflow.
solo.result: Still in sessions, with a lot of projects going.

solo.need: Wanted AI to become a daily habit.
solo.solution: One-to-one mentoring, then a daily practice she keeps herself.

solo.need: Wanted one place to keep and use what she learns.
solo.solution: Private sessions: a second brain and an art study partner.
solo.result: Still using both after the sessions ended.

solo.need: An owner who wanted AI in how she runs her business.
